title: At the Market
setting: A busy outdoor market with many food and clothes stalls.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots)

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan)

sentences.en: Ben and his sister Lily go to the market.
sentences.zh: 本和他的妹妹莉莉去集市。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and his little sister Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) walk into a busy outdoor market with fruit and clothes stalls.

sentences.en: First, their mum Anna gets money from the bank.
sentences.zh: 首先，妈妈安娜从银行取了钱。
sentences.scene_prompt: Outside a bank, Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) takes paper money from a cash machine while Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) wait beside her.

sentences.en: Many people sell fruit and fresh bread here.
sentences.zh: 很多人在这里卖水果和新鲜面包。
sentences.scene_prompt: Market stalls full of colourful fruit and fresh bread, with sellers handing bags to shoppers.

sentences.en: Lily has a question about the price of apples.
sentences.zh: 莉莉想问问苹果的价格。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) points at a pile of red apples and looks up at the fruit seller with a curious face.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Lily pointing at apples and asking the seller; the question about the price can't be shown.

sentences.en: The apples are cheap, only ten cents each.
sentences.zh: 苹果很便宜，每个只要十美分。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) gives a few tiny coins to the smiling fruit seller and gets a big bag of red apples.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Lily paying a few small coins for many apples; the exact price can't be shown.

sentences.en: Ben likes some jeans, but they are expensive.
sentences.zh: 本喜欢一条牛仔裤，但是很贵。
sentences.scene_prompt: At a clothes stall, Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) holds up a pair of blue jeans and gasps as the seller holds out a hand for a thick pile of paper money.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben liking the jeans and being shocked at the money asked; the price itself can't be shown.

sentences.en: So Ben keeps his dollars to spend on lunch.
sentences.zh: 所以本留着他的美元，用来买午饭。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) puts the jeans back on the stall and holds a few green dollar notes, looking over at a pizza stall.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben putting the jeans back and holding his money near a food stall; the plan to spend it on lunch can only be guessed.

sentences.en: They share a rich cheese pizza for lunch.
sentences.zh: 他们一起吃了一份浓郁的芝士比萨当午饭。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan), Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) share a big cheesy pizza at a market food stall.
